sources.title: Pneumonia Detection and Severity Grading Using YOLOv8
sources.snippet: Pneumonia remains a global health issue, especially in resource-limited settings where timely and accurate diagnosis is lacking. In this paper, we introduce a computer-aided pneumonia detection and severity grading system using a deep learning strategy based on the YOLOv8 classification model. sources.title: Pneumonia-Detection-YOLO/DOCUMENTATION.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: Pneumonia-Detection-YOLO is a beginner-friendly medical AI project that uses YOLOv8 object detection to identify and localize pneumonia-affected regions in chest X-ray images. The model draws bounding boxes around suspected infection areas to assist in early diagnosis and medical image analysis.
